description.text:
How much does a condo or apartment in Phnom Penh cost?
For condos or apartments available for sale in Phnom Penh, we currently have 2,090 with prices ranging from $66,014 to $229,662, and the median property price is $114,654.

What property types and features are most popular?
The stock is distributed across 5 different property types comprising mostly of condos, apartments, studios and serviced apartments, and the top features of these properties are lift / elevator, car parking, swimming pool and city views.

What are the most popular suburbs in Phnom Penh?
Out of all the locations in Phnom Penh the most popular suburbs are Boeng Keng Kang, Chamkarmon and Meanchey where you have a total of 1,484 properties.

The average bedroom count ranges from 1 to 2 bedrooms, with the most popular being 1 bedrooms in Phnom Penh. The majority of these properties also offers a bathroom range between 1 and 2 with a median of 1 parking spots per property

According to our data the majority of the properties faces north followed by south and east facing alternatives.

Condos and apartments in Phnom Penh have an average floor area of 60 with the lowest area being 40 square meters and the largest being 101 square meters.

The latest property listing was uploaded 3 hours, 15 minutes ago. A few different agencies are selling these properties, with realestate.com.kh (main account) and CENTURY 21 REGENT REALTY being the top agencies.
